description:
PR 3331 fixes protocol.file_patches, which used str.splitlines() and so treated form feed, vertical tab, U+2028 and U+0085 inside diff lines as line breaks. The controller's grep of origin/develop found the same call in _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/diff.py line 20 (for line in diff_text.splitlines()), which parses the pull-request diff, probably to compute commentable lines and positions for inline review comments (re-verify what it feeds). If a control character inside an added line makes the parser see extra lines, its line numbers drift and comments or the 'defects on diff lines' placement can anchor to the wrong line or be dropped. Other splitlines() calls found (absence.py 168-169, cli.py 147 and 167, evidence.py 49, verdict.py 409 and 421, oracle_review_check.py 107) parse comment, stderr or reviewer text, not diffs: confirm each is not diff-derived and record that.

DECISION GATE: first reproduce (a diff with a form feed inside an added line through diff.py and its callers: do the commentable line numbers shift?). If there is no effect on any consumer, record the evidence and finish with no change. If there is, fix diff.py to split on newline only, with a failing-before test.
